# coval_metrics (Data Source)

Retrieves all Coval metrics matching public API filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coval_metrics" "production" {
  filter          = "metric_type=METRIC_LLM_BINARY"
  tag_filters     = ["production"]
  order_by        = "metric_name asc"
  include_builtin = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String)
- `include_builtin` (Boolean) Include Coval built-in metrics.
- `order_by` (String)
- `page_size` (Number)
- `tag_filters` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `metrics` (Attributes List) All matching metric summaries. Use the singular coval_metric data source for polymorphic and nested configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics))
